name: Trustly Group AB
customer_base_segment: B2B2C — sells to gambling operators (Caesars Digital, Hard Rock Bet, FanDuel, DraftKings) who embed it at checkout for end players
business_model_notes: Open-banking 'Pay by Bank' payment initiation: instant account-to-account deposits and payouts for operators, monetized via per-transaction merchant fees; no card networks involved.
revenue_traction: Q4 2025 revenue SEK 650M (+5% YoY constant currency), adj. EBITDA SEK 82.1M; ~$100B total payment volume processed in 2025, 120M+ users
existing_partnerships: Caesars Digital, Hard Rock Bet, FanDuel, DraftKings (deposits/payouts), Nordic Capital (majority owner since 2018), SlimPay (acquired, closed May 2026)
licensed_jurisdictions: Authorised Payment Institution under PSD2 in Sweden (Finansinspektionen), passported across EU/EEA (30+ markets); FCA-authorised in UK; US operations for gaming payments
responsible_gambling_stance: Markets responsible-gaming features built on open-banking transaction data (e.g. affordability signals), not a public RG policy statement
foundation_model_approach: Uses ML/AI for payment-timing prediction and fraud scoring; no evidence of building or fine-tuning foundation models
proprietary_data_advantage: Transaction and bank-linkage data across 650M+ consumers reachable via 12,000+ connected banks
w_notes: Invisible B2B payments rail; strengthens operators' wallets, no attack on model
SlimPay deal expands recurring-payments infra, not player acquisition or AI
Deep integrations with Caesars, FanDuel, DraftKings, Hard Rock — commercial
Trustly ID (biometric login), Scan & Pay, AI recurring payments shipped
No owned discovery/intent audience — used only inside operator checkout
d_notes: No odds, markets or games content — pure payments infrastructure
No PAM, bonusing or trading rail; payments-only infrastructure
PSD2-passported across EU/EEA (30+ markets) plus UK FCA plus US ops
Dominant Pay-by-Bank rail in EU iGaming, $100B+ volume, not full MoR
Recognized checkout payment option, not a consumer destination brand
ai_notes: ML for payment-timing prediction/fraud; no evidence of own foundation models
AI predicts payment timing and fraud risk — assistive, not agentic
No evidence of MCP/A2A/UCP/ACP agent-commerce protocol adoption
No public customer-facing conversational assistant found
Post-SlimPay: predicts optimal payment timing per account, not offers
Transaction data across 650M+ linked consumers/12k banks is a real asset
Consumes AI/ML for internal fraud and payment-timing use only
f_notes: Nordic Capital-backed since 2018 (~€700M take-private); well-funded PE owner
Positive adj. EBITDA (SEK 82.1M Q4 2025) but modest ~5% revenue growth
PE-backed and EBITDA-positive; runway not a going-concern issue
Private LBO-style capital structure; leverage terms not publicly disclosed
Attempted Nasdaq Stockholm IPO at ~SEK75bn; now exploring ~$10B sale/IPO
evidence_notes: Scale/product claims well-sourced from Trustly's own press releases; financial figures conflict between official Q4 press release (SEK 650M quarterly revenue) and a third-party estimate site (getlatka.com, ~$101M full-year) — the official figure is treated as more reliable, but exact FY2025 revenue is not independently confirmed, so confidence held at medium. Leverage (F4) genuinely unknown — private company.
impact_on_incumbent_line: Makes deposits/payouts instant for whichever operator uses it, strengthening rather than bypassing the operator's own wallet — but Trustly concentrates the payments/wallet pillar, making it a likely partner or acquisition target for any future direct-to-player challenger.
residual_gap: No odds/content, no owned player audience, and not a full merchant-of-record — enables the wallet pillar for operators but shows no visible ambition to own the player relationship itself.
notes: Legal entity Trustly Group AB, Stockholm; majority-owned by Nordic Capital since a 2018 take-private (~€700M). Distinct from 'Trust Payments' (UK-based rival, unrelated brand, avoid conflating in dedupe checks) and from crypto's 'Trust Wallet' (unrelated, surfaced in search noise). Currently exploring a ~$10B sale or IPO per October 2024 Bloomberg reporting; no confirmed outcome found as of this research (July 2026).
